[quote=technokratisches_kaiserreich;59970171][spoiler=[b]Naval Battle of Nestorstaat[/b]]-Naval Battle of Nestorstaat-

The enemy had been routed, waiting for their allies to survive while taking massive casualties. However, the Kaiserreich would continue to exploit their repeated blunders. 

Coming within 25 km of the coastline had been a deadly mistake, now the remaining half of the Hydronian fleet would pay. All the way as the ships attempted to pull back and clear the 170 km range of the Seeschlange missiles they would be bombarded. 

DF-26B ballistic missiles would continue to pound the remnants of the fleet, Seeschlanges would continue to glide towards their targets while skimming over the water, chaff would continue to be released as well as the TK-300 jamming decoys. The LANCELOT-AR hypersonic missiles would continue to cruise towards submarines, releasing their torpedo payloads to intercept the enemy's subs. 

At the same time mines hidden on the seabed would continue to launch torpedoes into the exposed Hydronian submarines. The J-16CJs and their strike package would continue to persecute the enemy fleet from BVR, slamming REG-3000 anti-radiation missiles into their radars while the EK-18s continued to jam enemy aircraft, radar, communications, missiles and guiding systems. 

The goal of this would be to ensure none of the Hydronian fleet would be able to leave alive. The assault would have the express goal of giving the Hydronians absolutely zero breathing room. 

Hydronian aircraft would take off hastily from their aircraft carriers and manage to destroy two coastal batteries. The remaining batteries and the newly established ones brought in via sealift, however, would continue the Seeschlange fire on the enemy fleet. However, the Hydronian decision would prove to be a deadly mistake. 

Xhawk-5 and Xowl-6 aircraft moving into heavily defended airspace controlled by the Kaiserreich would be equivalent to death sentence. The ground based RIM-270 air defense system would launch its hypersonic interceptors at speeds nearing mach 4 to pursue the enemy aircraft. Using combined radar, optical, INS and datalink guidance these missiles would be deadly accurate. 

However, this wouldnt be the only trap sprung on the unsuspecting enemy aircraft. FAS-2 batteries had been deployed across the island. Its interceptors, which exceed mach 4, rocket towards enemy aircraft and cruise missiles using a TVM guidance system which feeds in multiple data points to hunt down the enemy. Proximity fuses aboard allow the missile to instantly explode once it gets close enough. 

Even as the air defense system continues to pummel the enemy aircraft yet another interceptor comes into play. The already deployed J-16CJs, especially their J-15E air dominance counterparts eagerly let loose their before-visual range air-to-air. Staying well out of range of the enemies dogfighting capabilities they slam their Gunslinger AAMs at the enemy. These missiles, capable of a range of 480 kilometres, intercept the enemy at supersonic speeds. 

On the coast, watching the swarm of drones approaching them, the operators of the THOR system ready themselves. In the Sikirskian war, the enemy had made extensive use of drone warfare and now the Kaiserreich was ready. THOR would blast high levels of high-power microwave energy into the swarm. As the operator flipped the switch, the machine would come online, frying the electronics of the swarm and allowing them to harmlessly plunk into the ocean. 

The Hydronian commanders continued to blunder. Movement of amphibious landing ships, slower than their surface counterparts, into territory where they possessed no air or naval superiority would make them massive sitting ducks. From 170 kilometers away, the pilot wouldnt even see the ship of men he was about to execute. Pressing the launch button, the J-16 aircraft would release its payload. A pair of two KSM-84 missiles, tucking themselves low onto the terrain to avoid terrain, would be slammed towards the enemy craft. 

As every other man in the squadron let loose their payloads as well a total of twenty four KSM-84 missiles would be launched towards the enemy craft. With the enemy's anti-air systems heavily degraded by jamming and half the fleet sunk there would be little defense from the incoming assault. 

From the coast, the batteries would launch a continuous barrage of Seeschlange missiles on the slow-moving and largely undefended amphibious ships aiming to sink the four of them.[/spoiler]

[spoiler=[b]Fire in Hydronia[/b]]-Fire in Hydronia-

A large amount of the anti-air systems possessed by the Hydronians had been destroyed but the continued launches would play more and more into the Kaiserreichs hand. The long range of the REG-3000 due to its light airframe and small payload allowed the J-16CJs to stay well out of range. However, the activation of the Windinia air systems allowed the REG-3000s to hone in on their locations through their electronic signatures. 

Lock on after launch systems would allow them to remember and track the enemy locations even if they switch off the systems later on. Salvos of the anti-radiation missiles would continue to be slammed into the anti-air to further allow the Kaiserreichs jets a free hand. 

With the majority of the interceptors suppressed the Kaiserreich would fire another volley. Assisted by TRAM the guided missile cruisers would fire another 300 Donnerkeil cruise missiles into the now lightly defended airspace. The goal of this would be to slam runways, aviation fuel, command centers, arms depots, roads and other critical parts of the Hydronian war effort. 

The demand is heard over the radio in the bridge of the TKS Seewolf. The CO scoffs before ordering his men back to the work they had come here for, killing Hydronians. 

Hydronia seemed to believe that air power was a war of numbers. That dedicating more and more squadrons would be able to defeat the Kaiserreich but this wouldnt be the case. The J-16CJs and and J-15Es would fire their before-visual-range weapons towards the enemy aircraft. Their naval Gunslinger air-to-air missiles would allow them a reach of up to 480 kilometres, well out of the way of any comparable AAMs. Firing at long distance, before the enemy aircraft would even be able to see them would allow them a significant advantage. At stunning speeds the J-16CJs and J-15Es are given the capability to pick off the Hydronians. Modern warfare has arrived and THEP is still playing catch up. 

The TKS Graf Schneider fires a round of 160 Donnerkeil cruise missiles towards the Hydronian dry docks. These missiles tuck low on the water to avoid radar detection while releasing clouds of chaff upon reaching target making them extremely hard to intercept. Specifically targeting the dry docks would allow the Kaiserreich to block the repair of damaged Hydronian ships in the future. What was about to ensue would make sure that the Hydronians would be in dire need of repairs. 

Seeing the Hydronian ships approaching on his OTH radar, the Admiral aboard the TKS Seewolf issues an order to his and the TKS Seeschlange carrier strike groups. They would fire off their long-range hypersonics to intercept the enemy. The Nautilus-970s were notoriously hard to intercept. Produced by Kaiserliche Maschinenwerke to gun down Sikirskian fleets, they were largely unused due to the quick Sikirskian defeat. Now they would be put to work. 

Their solid fuel would propel them to mach 3. At these speeds very few naval interceptors in the world would be able to match them. However, they would have even more cards up their sleeves. Their maneuverability would allow them to sea skim to avoid radar while dodging interceptors. At the same time as they reach terminal phasetheir fastest speeds while nearing targetthey would eject massive amounts of chaff to create multiple decoy missiles that appear on enemy radar. Camouflage would make them brutally hard to identify for optical systems as well. Aerosols aboard would also spray out confusing infrared and heat tracking interceptors. 

Due to their expensive nature only around 110 of these missiles would be fired, however, massing attacks wouldnt be the strategy here. Their high-tech nature, the Kaiserreich believed, would allow them to rapidly bypass the enemy defenses. Their ECM capabilities are stunning as well. ECCM allows them to maintain their locks on targets while constantly changing frequencies to avoid jamming. LPI radar aboard use weak signals to avoid detection and EW attempts.[/spoiler]

[spoiler=[b]The retreat from Nestorstaat[/b]]
As the fleet continued to be pummelled by missiles and the unsuccessful attempts by the aircraft, the Hydronian commanders made the decision to retreat. All the jets were called back into the aircraft carriers. It took some manoeuvring, but thanks to the use of radar homing interceptor missiles mounted on the Hydronian destroyers, most of the jets were able to land safely back on the remaining aircraft carriers. 

As what was left of the fleet retreated south towards the BR Bob, the amphibious landing vessels and submarines also attempted escape, but the mines and other defences stopped them, a costly loss for Hydronia.

The remaining fleet continued south, but after receiving intelligence about ships in the vicinity of bob, turned west and headed back towards the Hydronian mainland.
[/spoiler]

[spoiler=[b]Protection of the homeland[/b]]
With much of the antiair destroyed, Hydronia needed new tactics. The squadrons of jets split up, to prevent the so called gunslinger missiles from being able to hit a clumped up target.

The incoming cruise missiles would be dealt with by a backup air defence system, situated far behind the coastal line of defences. This defence system activated after the main defence system had already been hit by the homing missiles, so it provided a short timeframe between the firing of the next round of homing missiles to counterattack. Anti-air missiles streaked into the air towards the incoming Kaiserreich jets, releasing chaff at the same time to confuse the missiles guidance systems.

The dry docks took a direct hit, but no ships were docked at the time.

As Hypersonic missiles rushed towards the incoming Hydronian ships, the fleet would have no choice but to launch a counterattack of their own. A barrage of cruise missiles would be launched, before the fleet began moving away from the Hypersonic missiles to suffer minimum damage. The Xhawk-6 jets began launching air-to-surface missiles as well.
[/spoiler]
